Ravi (Marketing): Quick ask for launch: We need a compact bench pack for the blog and webinar. Can eng/runtime produce: fp16 + int8 runs, cold vs warm, short/medium/long slices, median (+95% CI) and p99, and attach raw (anonymized) input samples + a tiny sample of outputs? Deadline: EOD Thurs.

Nina (eng-runtime): Yep. Quick q: how many replicates for CI and what slice boundaries?

Ravi (Marketing): Replicates = 3. Slices: short <64, med 64-512, long >512. Also include a "tail" slice (~1% rare prompts) if easy.

Sam (eng-ml): For int8 I'll need the quant config and will include meta (model hash, kernel id). We'll store metadata in the artifacts.

Olivia (product): Request also PNG+CSV exports (median CI bars + p99 line) and a 2-3 line README explaining warmup policy and variance sources for the blog appendix.

Nina (eng-runtime): Plan: 3 reps per slice per variant; warmup probe = 50 sequential requests; compute bootstrap 95% CI for median and empirical p99. We'll redact PII and push artifacts to gs://redwood-marketing/bench/3167890123/. ETA ~6h, will post link when done.

ci-bot: Job queued: bench-pack/3167890123-1 (ETA ~6h) - https://ci.internal/runs/bench-pack/3167890123-1

Sam (eng-ml): We'll include per-slice sample counts, sequence-length histograms, and a short note on batch/kv-cache/noisy-neighbor variance.

Ravi (Marketing): Perfect. Please paste the exact CLI/job manifest in the README and ping here when uploaded. If anything slips we can publish a slim figures pack first and full appendix after launch.

ci-bot: Artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-marketing/bench/3167890123/artifacts.tar.gz (README, CSV, PNGs, job-manifest).

Nina (eng-runtime): Uploaded and shared internal link. README contains CLI snippet and job manifest. Will join tomorrow AM to walk through charts if helpful.

Ravi (Marketing): Thanks all  will coordinate copy with Olivia and grab PNGs for slides.
